completed_subtasks.subtask: Create the basic file structure for the Tic-Tac-Toe web application. This should include an `index.html` file, a `style.css` file for basic styling, and an empty `script.js` file to be populated later. The `index.html` should set up the basic HTML page and link the CSS and JS files.

Design the core data structures for the Tic-Tac-Toe game logic in `script.js`. This includes how the game board will be represented (e.g., a 2D array or a flat array), how the current player will be tracked, and how to identify a win condition (rows, columns, diagonals).
Create the index.html file with the basic HTML structure and link the css and js files.

Based on the previously designed data structures, implement the functional game logic within `script.js`. This should include: 1) a function to handle player clicks on cells, updating the board state; 2) a function to check for win/draw conditions after each move; and 3) a function to reset the game to its initial state.
Generate the `style.css` file to provide basic visual formatting for the Tic-Tac-Toe game. Define the styles for the game board grid and the individual cells.

Integrate the implemented game logic from script.js with the index.html DOM structure. Add necessary DOM manipulation code to script.js to update the board UI and display the game status based on the logical state. Set up the event listeners for cells and the restart button.

Integrate the visual elements in `index.html` with the implemented logic in `script.js`. Specifically, modify `index.html` to create a grid of 9 cells (e.g., using `<div>` elements) that correspond to the game board. Ensure each cell has appropriate `class` names for styling from `style.css` and can handle click events (e.g., via `onclick` or by adding event listeners in `script.js`). Add a status display element to show the current player or game outcome, and a reset button that triggers the reset function in `script.js`.
